reserveReview.rationale: The September 29 dashboard observations are retained as historical gross product-deposit context: $46,668,112 trove collateral, $107,330,000 Prime Vault deposits and $17,620,553.57 Smart Vault deposits, totaling $171,618,666. Those amounts produced the retained 27.19%, 62.54% and 10.27% contextual weights. River's current Smart Vault documentation says deposits deploy into DeFi, CeDeFi and RWA strategies and internally minted satUSD depends on a governance-controlled staking factor. No complete current strategy holdings, product liabilities or whole-token reconciliation was disclosed in that source. The former 125.2% gross-deposits-to-circulation comparison is not accepted as reserve coverage. Under D24 these selected observations cannot establish a score-bearing full composition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Historical September 29, 2026 gross product-deposit observations, normalized only for contextual display; no reconciled whole-token backing denominator
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current full liability-weighted composition is unverified. The retained 10.27% is the fingerprinted unresolved Smart Vault share within historical observed deposits, not a measured whole-token unknown-exposure percentage. Vault-level completeness, deployed strategy assets and liabilities, internally minted satUSD, Prime Vault assignments and safeguarding terms remain unresolved. No missing remainder is inferred.

Published wallet holdings, deployed strategy claims, and the liabilities minted by each vault must be reconciled before linking a weighted USDT dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: River names Ceffu and Cobo as Prime Vault custodians on its homepage; this is an issuer disclosure, not an independent custodian attestation. The legal entities, asset-level assignments, quantitative shares, wallet addresses, safeguarding terms, jurisdictions, insolvency treatment and contractual rehypothecation rights are not established. Smart Vault documentation describes institutional custodian wallets without naming providers. The general terms describe a non-custodial interface and do not establish a product-specific Prime/Smart custody agreement. No regulatory status, insurance coverage, segregation, bankruptcy protection or full-backing composition is inferred.
